$doc: The iPhone app's tokens (ADR-0065 §5, design/mobile.md §A.8), set under :root[data-platform='ios'] in dist/platform-ios.css. Only the phone app loads that file. Numbers are Apple's Human Interface Guidelines' (developer.apple.com/design/human-interface-guidelines) and UIKit's, each with its spec in `spec`. The neutrals are the HIG system colours (light and dark), the tint and the semantic colours are wisp's (var(--accent), var(--good), …). Springs are rendered to CSS linear() curves from SwiftUI's duration and bounce. Names shared with tokens.css (--radius-xs…xl, --bar-h) override the browser value inside the app only, on purpose; no other name may collide (test/platform.test.ts). The tonal surfaces are --surface-c0…c4 (§A.8's --surface-0…4) and the rail --nav-rail-w, because tokens.css's --surface-2 and the stage's --rail-w already mean something else.

tap-min.spec: HIG Accessibility › Buttons and controls: hit targets at least 44 × 44 pt

bar-h-large.spec: UIKit UINavigationBar with prefersLargeTitles: 44 pt bar + 52 pt large title

nav-h.spec: UIKit UITabBar: 49 pt above the home indicator (safe-bottom)

nav-rail-w.spec: UISplitViewController: primary column 320 pt (the iPad sidebar)

row-h-1.spec: HIG Lists and tables / UITableView: default row 44 pt

row-h-2.spec: UIListContentConfiguration.subtitleCell: about 60 pt with body + footnote

row-h-3.spec: a three-line cell (body + two footnote lines) at the large text size

inset.spec: UITableView layout margins: 16 pt on iPhone

hairline.spec: HIG separators: one device pixel (0.5 pt on 2× and 3× screens)

radius-sm.spec: HIG: buttons in the small size

radius-lg.spec: HIG Buttons: large button and grouped background corners 12 pt

radius-xl.spec: HIG: large cards and the context menu preview

font-ui.spec: HIG Typography: San Francisco (SF Pro), the system font, not shipped

type-large-title.spec: HIG Typography › Dynamic Type sizes (Large): Large Title 34/41

primary.spec: HIG Color: the app's tint = wisp's accent

error.spec: destructive actions in red = wisp's bad

state-hover.spec: HIG: no hover on iPhone (the pointer on iPad uses the highlight)

state-focus.spec: keyboard focus on iPad, same layer as M3 for one kit rule

state-pressed.spec: UIKit highlighted state: the control dims (design/mobile.md §A.5)

elev-1.spec: HIG publishes no shadow numbers: a resting card (UIKit approximation)

dur-short.spec: UIKit: a short transition (keyboard and toggle animations ≈ 0.25 s)

dur-medium.spec: UIKit: a push or sheet transition ≈ 0.35 s

swipe-line.spec: Mail: a full swipe past half the row runs the first action

safe-top.spec: HIG Layout › Safe areas: the status bar, the notch, the Dynamic Island

tab-icon.spec: UITabBarItem: compact glyph about 25 × 25 pt (SF Symbols in the tab bar)

type-tab.spec: UITabBar item title: SF 10 pt medium

tab-gap.spec: UITabBar: about 2 pt between the glyph and its title

tab-pad-top.spec: UITabBar: the glyph sits about 7 pt below the bar top on iPhone

bar-pad.spec: UINavigationBar: bar button items 8 pt from the layout margin (16 pt edge with the 8 pt button padding)

bar-button-gap.spec: UINavigationBar: about 6 pt between trailing bar button items

large-title-pad-bottom.spec: UINavigationBar large title: 8 pt below the baseline box

ease-standard.spec: iOS moves on springs: the kit's one easing name follows SwiftUI .smooth

chrome.spec: UIBarAppearance default background (systemChromeMaterial): the tab bar and a scrolled navigation bar
